Acceptance Criteria:
- Admins can join state/federal elections
- Admins can create local-only elections
- All decisions remain state-controlled
- Correct visibility rules enforced

Summary: As a jurisdiction admin, I can view all elections I am eligible to join so I know which elections affect my area
Acceptance Criteria:
- My Elections dashboard shows two tabs: 'Joinable Elections' and 'My Elections'
- Joinable Elections list is auto-populated from parent jurisdictions
- Each row shows election name, date, type, and jurisdiction level
- Only elections from higher-level jurisdictions appear

Summary: As a jurisdiction admin, I can join an existing state or federal election with one click
Acceptance Criteria:
- 'Join' button visible only on eligible elections
- Clicking Join adds my jurisdiction as participant instantly
- Confirmation toast + audit log entry
- I am immediately redirected to Ballot Design for that election

Summary: As a jurisdiction admin, I can create a new local-only election
Acceptance Criteria:
- 'Create New Local Election' button visible only if jurisdiction level allows (county, city, district)
- Form requires: name, date, voting start/end, election type
- On save → election created with status Draft and scoped only to my jurisdiction

Summary: As a state-level admin, I can create a statewide or federal-contest election that becomes joinable downstream
Acceptance Criteria:
- State admins see 'Create Statewide Election' option
- New election automatically marked as 'joinable' for all subordinate jurisdictions
- Lower-level admins see it immediately in their Joinable list

Summary: The system prevents counties/cities from creating statewide elections
Acceptance Criteria:
- Non-state admins do not see 'Create Statewide Election' option
- Attempting to force via API returns 403 Forbidden
- Audit log records attempted violation

Summary: As an admin, I can see a unified list of all elections my jurisdiction is participating in
Acceptance Criteria:
- 'My Elections' tab shows both joined and locally created elections
- Each row shows status (Draft, Approved, Active, Closed)

Summary: As an admin, I can proceed from any election directly to Ballot Design
Acceptance Criteria:
- 'Proceed to Ballot Design' button on every election row
- Click opens Ballot domain for that specific election

Summary: Election visibility respects jurisdiction hierarchy at all times
Acceptance Criteria:
- County admin never sees elections from other counties
- City admin only sees their own local + joined state elections
- State admin sees everything

Summary: As an admin, I can view detailed election metadata (dates, type, participating jurisdictions)
Acceptance Criteria:
- Election Details page shows full metadata
- List of participating jurisdictions
- Creation and modification timestamps

Summary: All election creation/joining actions are logged in ElectionObserver
Acceptance Criteria:
- Every join/create emits event to ElectionObserver
- Visible in public bulletin board under 'Election Lifecycle Events'
